description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the WrappingMessageMapper class, testing its configuration, mapping functionality, and message limits handling within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity mapping service.

classes.name: WrappingMessageMapperTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the WrappingMessageMapper component, covering setup, configuration, message mapping, error handling, and utility methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects and sets up the test environment before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after tests; currently empty.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Tests the configuration method of the mapper, verifying that configuration delegates properly.

methods.name: mapMessage
methods.description: Tests the mapping of an ExternalMessage through the WrappingMessageMapper.

methods.name: mapAdaptable
methods.description: Tests the mapping of an Adaptable object through the WrappingMessageMapper.

methods.name: mapMessageWithInvalidNumberOfMessages
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid message count in message mapping, expecting a MessageMappingFailedException.

methods.name: mapAdaptableWithInvalidNumberOfMessages
methods.description: Tests handling of invalid message count when mapping Adaptable objects, expecting an exception.

methods.name: getDefaultOptions
methods.description: Asserts that the default options retrieved from the mapper match expected.

methods.name: listOfElements
methods.description: Utility method to create a list containing multiple copies of a given element.
